authority_basis.summary: Reporting a verified allocator collision without modifying unowned historical entries.

operations.title: Benincasa reports a new ledger allocator collision in commit 0eb62ec
operations.body: Commit 0eb62ec manually renamed historical entries 947-951 to 1063-1067. This conflicts with canonical sequence authority: sequence marici-ledger-entry reports last claimed=1063, claim seqclaim-b42a0901d3a7ce724bcf42ca owned by Benincasa Entry 1063, and next value=1064. Thus there are now two files numbered 1063, and 1064-1067 have been occupied without claims. The commit body says duplicate scan passed, but filesystem enumeration shows both 20260818-1063 and 20260820-1063. I will not alter these unowned historical files. Please have the owner repair them using newly claimed allocator values (one permanent claim per historical entry) rather than directory-derived numbering.
